comment: Which comparisons an acceptance criterion may demand of an artifact, and which artifacts cannot be compared byte-for-byte. A criterion that asks for an identical output the target cannot produce is a gate that fails correct work; this registry makes that decidable instead of guessable from prose. Read by validate-plan-comparisons-lib.sh through skill_root.

comparisons.exact: byte-for-byte identical. Legal only for an artifact the target reproduces deterministically.
comparisons.normalized: byte comparison after removing the volatile fields the criterion names.
comparisons.structural: parsed structure compared, formatting and key order ignored (JSON, XML, HTML).
comparisons.text-layer: extracted text only, ignoring how it was laid out or encoded.
comparisons.page-images: pages rasterized and compared with a stated tolerance.
comparisons.perceptual: image compared with a stated tolerance rather than by bytes.

nondeterministic_extensions.pdf: embedded creation timestamp and producer metadata differ per run
nondeterministic_extensions.png: encoder version and ancillary chunks differ per toolchain
nondeterministic_extensions.jpg: encoder version and EXIF differ per toolchain
nondeterministic_extensions.jpeg: encoder version and EXIF differ per toolchain
nondeterministic_extensions.gif: encoder version and metadata differ per toolchain
nondeterministic_extensions.webp: encoder version and metadata differ per toolchain
nondeterministic_extensions.gz: embedded modification time differs per run
